snippet.title: Pokémon TCG Pocket | Deluxe Pack ex ✨
snippet.description:
Bring the bling to your collection with Pokémon TCG Pocket's Deluxe Pack ex!

The Deluxe Pack is guaranteed to include ♦♦♦♦ Pokémon ex cards from previous expansions from Genetic Apex to Wisdom of Sea and Sky. You'll also be able to collection "parallel foil" cards with a unique shine effect and previously released cards with brand-new artwork! 

Deluxe Pack ex will debut on Monday, September 29th at 11:00 p.m. PDT and will be available until Wednesday, October 29th at 10:59 p.m. PDT. 

Find all your favorite Pokémon merchandise at the official Pokémon Center: https://www.pokemoncenter.com/
